report.summary: Three narrowed/confirmed findings need work: define/import refresh_todo_snapshot in memory/__init__.py (critical), verify lane_for_host in vet.py (critical), and ensure build_forest_hierarchy filters type nodes in forest.py (high). One needs-evidence finding requires checking stub-only modules in correctness.py.
risks: Missing refresh_todo_snapshot breaks memory event logging silently.
Missing lane_for_host in vet.py means MCP egress detection is non-functional (critical security gap).
Type nodes leaking into forest layers corrupts reachability analysis.
Stub-only modules may cause correctness extraction failures.
todos: Define or import refresh_todo_snapshot in daedalus/memory/__init__.py.
Add lane_for_host function or import in daedalus/tools/vet.py.
Add _is_type_node_id filter in build_forest_hierarchy in daedalus/structcore/forest.py.
Audit correctness.py for handling of stub-only modules.

items.title: Define or import refresh_todo_snapshot in daedalus/memory/__init__.py
items.why_now: append_event calls refresh_todo_snapshot but it is missing; this breaks memory event persistence and blocks any feature depending on event logging.

steps.do: Search for existing definition of refresh_todo_snapshot in daedalus/memory/__init__.py; if not found, define it or import from an existing module (e.g., daedalus/memory/__main__.py or daedalus/kairos/drafts.py).
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'refresh_todo_snapshot' daedalus/memory/__init__.py && python -c 'from daedalus.memory import append_event; append_event()'

items.assumption: The function refresh_todo_snapshot should exist somewhere in the codebase; if not, we must implement a minimal version that writes to TODO_PATH.

items.title: Add lane_for_host function or import in daedalus/tools/vet.py
items.why_now: Without lane_for_host, MCP egress detection in vet.py fails, creating a critical security hole for MCP server vetting.

steps.do: Search full vet.py for lane_for_host definition or import; if missing, add import from daedalus/lanes/checks.py or daedalus/lanes/fanout.py.
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'lane_for_host' daedalus/tools/vet.py && python -c 'from daedalus.tools.vet import lane_for_host'

items.assumption: lane_for_host is defined in daedalus/lanes/checks.py or daedalus/lanes/fanout.py; if not, we must create a minimal function that returns a lane based on host.

items.title: Add _is_type_node_id filter in build_forest_hierarchy in daedalus/structcore/forest.py
items.why_now: Missing type node filtering may cause type nodes to leak into file layers, corrupting reachability analysis and potentially causing incorrect mapping results.

steps.do: Inspect build_forest_hierarchy function; if _is_type_node_id is not called, add a filter to exclude type nodes from file layers.

items.assumption: build_forest_hierarchy exists in forest.py and _is_type_node_id is defined; we assume the filter logic is straightforward.

items.title: Audit correctness.py for stub-only module handling
items.why_now: If _disambiguate returns a .pyi file as the only source, correctness.py may fail to extract tests or evaluate them because stubs have no runtime code.

steps.do: Find modules that are only .pyi files and check if correctness.py or any caller treats them as runtime modules; add a check to skip stub-only modules or handle gracefully.

items.assumption: There exists at least one stub-only module in the repository; the fix should be defensive regardless.
